description: Emails a non-clinical consultation request through the Cloudflare Email binding after the visitor explicitly confirms. Do not collect date of birth, insurance, or clinical information. Consultation requests are routed through Found For AI (foundforai.com), who will pass them to Goldsberry Orthodontics. The office then contacts the visitor to schedule.

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the visitor reviews and approves the details.

note.description: Optional non-clinical scheduling note (500 characters or fewer).

preferred_contact_method.description: How the office should follow up.
